reading.body:
No operator-published specifications for power capacity, cooling, or IT infrastructure were found for Searcy Information Technologies. The facility is recorded as municipal government IT infrastructure operated by the City of Searcy, a municipality of approximately 23,000 people, rather than as a commercial data center. Research on the operator's published materials was exhausted without locating technical specifications or capacity figures.

Arkansas has two mapped data center facilities on record, neither with published power capacity. Searcy Information Technologies cannot be ranked against peers in the state because no megawatt figures are available from any operator in Arkansas. The state publishes no disclosed capacity on which to measure whether this facility is material to regional AI infrastructure.

Whether this campus matters to AI scaling depends on unpublished information: the IT load in megawatts, the class of compute hardware hosted, and the available power budget for growth. None of these facts are in the public record. A reader evaluating AI infrastructure should contact the City of Searcy directly to determine whether this is a municipal IT closet or a facility of scale.
